evidence.detail: Explicitly removes load_people_stats and merges all stats into a single load_people query via preaggregation, resolving the performance concern that motivated the optional-flag request
Current load_people has all stats (wins, losses, win_percent, tournament_wins, etc.) inline in one SQL query; no separate load_people_stats function exists

triage.notes: The issue requested an optional flag for performance; the actual fix used preaggregation to make a combined query fast enough to always include stats, making the flag unnecessary. Issue can be closed.
